high_level_description: The image features a person standing against a plain white background. The individual is wearing a strapless, beige-colored corset-style dress that fits closely to the body, accentuating the figure. Over the dress, they have draped a fluffy, light-colored fur stole or shawl over their shoulders and arms, adding a luxurious and elegant touch to the outfit. The person's hair is dark and styled in a sleek, high ponytail. The person is also wearing a pair of high-heeled shoes with a metallic or gold ankle strap, which complements the overall look.
